story: Netflix released 'Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly' on September 1, 2026 — a full-length documentary about Australian breakdancer Rachael Gunn, who scored zero points in all three rounds of her Paris 2024 Olympic debut and whose performance contributed to breaking being dropped from the 2028 Games; critics called the documentary 'more infuriating than the performance itself.'
why_funny: The logical response to embarrassing an entire sport off the Olympic program is apparently a Netflix documentary asking you to feel bad about it.
